environment.description: ECS Fargate task with IAM role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/docprocessor-worker-gated. The role's inline policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition to restrict PutItem/UpdateItem/GetItem to items where the partition key (tenantId) matches the value injected via aws:PrincipalTag/TenantAssignment (set by STS session tag from the task's OIDC federation). Additionally, the task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true with a tmpfs mount at /var/spool/docprocessor/output (size 512MB, noexec,nosuid,nodev mount options). The ECS task definition also sets 'user': '65534:65534' (nobody). An SCP on the OU denies dynamodb:* unless aws:RequestedRegion equals 'us-east-1' and the resource ARN matches the specific table.

scp_condition.condition: StringNotEquals aws:RequestedRegion us-east-1 AND ArnNotLike resource table/tenant-documents

config.session_tag_source: OIDC federation with immutable TenantAssignment claim
